youtube.title: Microwave mein khana kahin garam, kahin thanda kyun rehta hai? 🥶 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Kabhi microwave mein khana garam kiya hai aur ek jagah ubal raha ho, dusri jagah bilkul thanda? Microwaves dabbe ke andar idhar-udhar uchhalti hain aur ek doosre par overlap karti hain. Jahan waves ek saath judti hain, wahan khana garam hota hai. Jahan woh ek doosre ko cancel kar deti hain, wahan lagbhag kuch nahi hota.

Isiliye microwave mein turntable hota hai, jo aapke khane ko hot spots se ghumata hai. Turntable nikaal kar chocolate ka bar microwave karo, to aapko ek line mein pighle hue spots dikhenge. Unke beech ka gap naapo, to aap light ki speed nikaal sakte ho.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
